messages:
liz: quick design check — compact role cards mock uploaded. Q: show SSO as an inline switch or a small status chip that opens a confirm popover? goal = scannability + safe toggles.
raj: chip for quick scan, but it must be actionable. clicking should open confirm (don't toggle immediately).
noah: accessibility: chip must be a real button (aria-pressed) and tabbable. popovers need focus trap and Esc to close. hiding SSO in overflow is bad for discoverability.
emma: a11y scan flagged chip contrast ~3:1. need 4.5:1 for small text. tooltips must appear on focus and hover.
tess: product: when enabling SSO show modal listing affected users + "I understand" checkbox. bulk ops require per-role counts.
a11y-bot: checks to run after prototype: chip contrast, popover focus trap, modal aria-describedby for affected list, menu role attributes for kebab.
liz: action items: update Figma with chip+popover by tomorrow; product to write modal + bulk copy (tess); eng to implement button semantics & deep-link for audit entries (noah); emma/a11y-bot to re-scan after. I'll ping when mocks updated. :thumbsup:
